content.text:
I fixed the bug and all 4 tests now pass.

**The bug:** The tests number pages from 1, so `pageOf(1)` should return the five newest issues. But `src/offset.js` worked out the start position as `page * perPage`, which assumes pages start at 0. That shifted every page forward by one: page 1 returned issues 7–3 instead of 12–8, and page 3 came back empty instead of returning `[2, 1]`.

**The fix:** In `src/offset.js`, I changed the formula to `(page - 1) * perPage`. Only `src/page.js` uses `offset`, so nothing else is affected.

I haven't committed the change.
